sentences.text:
4. The main submissions advanced by learned counsel for the appellant are that appellant's earlier prayer was rejected on 07.02.2023 with granting a liberty to him to renew his prayer for bail after completion of half of the sentence of rigorous imprisonment of ten years awarded upon him and now he has completed the half sentence accordingly, in the light of the said liberty he has again come before this court.
5.

Learned counsel appearing for the Informant has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant and submitted that there is serious allegation against the appellant and there is sufficient incriminating evidence including the medical evidence to support the allegation of sexual assault and in this regard medical evidence given by the doctor concerned may be perused.
6.
Learned APP appearing for the State has also opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant.
7. Heard both the sides.

Though, the appellant has completed the half sentence of rigorous imprisonment of ten years awarded upon him, however considering the seriousness Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.129 of 2022(9) dt.18-12-2023 of the allegation appearing against him, this Court is not inclined to accept the present prayer of the appellant.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail stands rejected.
8. In the result, the instant I.A. No. 1 of 2023 stands, rejected.
Cr. APP(SJ) No. 129 of 2022 9.
Let the appeal be listed under the heading "For Hearing" on 22.01.2024.

(Shailendra Singh, J) Maynaz/-
